mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating labor market strength) and low UNRATE (below 4.2%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month consecutive decline in INDPRO, signaling supply chain disruptions, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 58% of instances with 2mo consecutive INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: RSAFS growth, as a proxy for consumer spending, consistently supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, given its direct impact on economic activity.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a rising FEDFUNDS and a concurrently increasing CPIAUCSL (above 2.5% YoY) amplifies inflation concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with both conditions met, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4.0%, indicating an unexpectedly strong labor market, surprises investors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as they reassess economic strength.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 52% of instances with UNRATE dropping below 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of increasing HOUST (above 1500 units) and concurrently rising RSAFS (above $600,000) signals robust demand across both housing and retail, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of instances with both conditions met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
